title: receive_rrep ignores signature field - auth bypass
description:
File: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs:300-314

The receive_rrep() method validates that RREP originator/destination/seq_num match the discovery, but completely ignores the signature field. An attacker can spoof route replies without a valid signature.

Failure scenario: Attacker sends RREP with matching addresses/seq but signature=None (or invalid signature). receive_rrep returns Ok, caller installs the route, traffic routed through attacker.

Fix: Either (a) require signature.is_some() and document that link layer verified it, or (b) pass a verified:bool flag from the link layer that this function checks, or (c) add SECURITY comment documenting that signature validation is the caller's responsibility after receive_rrep returns.
close_reason: Already fixed: receive_rrep() already checks signature.is_none() and returns LoadngError::MissingSignature (lines 447-451). Tests at lines 1102, 1466, 1495 verify the behavior.
